chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Ziyād al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said:
The shroud of a man's wife is upon the husband when she dies.

key_terms.إِذَا: when, introducing the condition for the ruling
key_terms.الزَّوْجِ: the husband, who bears the legal responsibility mentioned here
key_terms.امْرَأَتِهِ: his wife, whose shroud is being discussed
key_terms.كَفَنُ: the burial shroud required for preparing the deceased
key_terms.مَاتَتْ: she dies, the circumstance in which the ruling applies

ai.seo_question: Is a husband responsible for the kafan of his wife when she dies?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the husband bears responsibility for providing his wife's shroud upon her death. It pertains to funerary obligations within marriage and reflects the continuing financial duty of the husband in this matter.
